name: Brentuximab vedotin (single agent)

institution.provenance: StewardMD draft decision-support protocol (experimental, owner/device test only; not clinically activated)

supportiveCare: CD30-directed antibody-drug conjugate for relapsed/refractory classical Hodgkin lymphoma.
Cumulative peripheral neuropathy is dose-limiting; assess before each dose and hold or reduce for grade 2 or higher.
Monitor for infusion reactions and neutropenia.
monitoring: peripheral neuropathy assessment before each dose
CBC with differential before each dose
restaging imaging to assess response and duration

drugs.name: Brentuximab vedotin
drugs.notes: Brentuximab vedotin 1.8 mg/kg IV on day 1 every 21 days (single-agent relapsed/refractory dosing; body weight capped at 100 kg for dose calculation in practice, i.e. approximately 180 mg maximum per dose). Cumulative peripheral neuropathy: assess and hold/reduce for grade 2 or higher. Standard dosing (NCCN / DeVita general reference).
